title: Triennial full-scale deployment inspection.
officialText:
A full-scale deployment inspection initiated by the owner shall be conducted every three years in the presence of a special inspection agency that is qualified to perform flood zone compliance special inspections.

(L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
